_comment: The stock installer's labels on the AOSP PackageInstaller shipped with Android 12+ (API 31+), German locale. Measured on the API 35 LineageOS GSI (profile phone35): the buttons are sentence case ('Installieren' / 'Abbrechen'), a same-source update reads 'Aktualisieren', and an update whose app was installed by a *different* installer first asks 'Soll diese App von … aktualisiert werden?' with the button 'Trotzdem aktualisieren' — hence the two candidates. The harness matches case-insensitively. A profile points here with 'system_strings'; without it a run uses system.<lang>.json.
